# archestra_agent_skill_policy (Resource)

Authoritative activation-skill policy for one internal agent. Declare at most one per agent. Updates reject concurrent revisions and policies containing unavailable or hidden references. Destroy resets the policy to manual mode with no references, preserving the agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One authoritative policy per internal agent. Native references use skill_id;
# external_mcp uses mcp_server_id + uri; plugin uses plugin_id + skill_path.
resource "archestra_agent_skill_policy" "restricted" {
  agent_id            = archestra_agent.worker.id
  mode                = "manual"
  allowed_references  = []
  excluded_references = []
}

# Import with the internal agent UUID. Destroy clears all references and resets
# mode to manual; it preserves the agent. Hidden/unavailable references must be
# resolved explicitly before this policy can be managed.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Internal agent UUID.
- `allowed_references` (Attributes Set) Complete set of explicitly allowed skill references. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed_references))
- `excluded_references` (Attributes Set) Complete set of explicitly excluded skill references. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--excluded_references))
- `mode` (String) Skill activation mode.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Agent UUID identifying the policy.
- `revision` (Number) Last observed policy revision for optimistic concurrency.

<a id="nestedatt--allowed_references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowed_references`

Required:

- `source` (String) Reference source.

Optional:

- `mcp_server_id` (String) Installed MCP server UUID for an external skill.
- `plugin_id` (String) Plugin UUID.
- `skill_id` (String) Native skill UUID.
- `skill_path` (String) Skill path within the plugin.
- `uri` (String) External MCP skill URI.


<a id="nestedatt--excluded_references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `excluded_references`

Required:

- `source` (String) Reference source.

Optional:

- `mcp_server_id` (String) Installed MCP server UUID for an external skill.
- `plugin_id` (String) Plugin UUID.
- `skill_id` (String) Native skill UUID.
- `skill_path` (String) Skill path within the plugin.
- `uri` (String) External MCP skill URI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by internal agent UUID.
terraform import archestra_agent_skill_policy.restricted 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
